interface.title: OPTIMEO (Streamlit app: Design Of Experiments / Bayesian Optimization / Data Analysis and Modeling)
interface.field: Process chemistry and materials science: experimental design and process optimization
interface.stage_of_work: Planning experiments, choosing the next experiments after a first batch, and analysing results
interface.what_it_is_for: Generate a design of experiments for process factors, fit a Bayesian model to the measured outcomes to suggest the next most informative runs, and fit statistical or ML models to see which factors drive the response.

data.note: The Design page needed no data; factors were typed in (Temperature 20–80 with an intermediate level of 50, ConcentrationA −1 to 1, Catalyst categorical Pd/Ni/Cu). The Bayesian Optimization page used experimental_data2.csv (4 rows: Temperature, Concentration, Yield, Price). The Data Analysis page first showed that same dataset carried over from the other page, then used dataML.csv (50 rows: temp, cA, cB, cC, response). At 127.0.0.1 the Home page and the first page load stayed blank while 'Running'. The pages rendered when opened at localhost:8501, and all later screens come from there.

Only a single objective was seen to work; the two-outcome run did not finish and then raised an Ax UserInputError (052). Fixed parameters, constraints and UCB tuning were not run
